pictures.name: BV1-Lumbini-Garden
pictures.prompt: A lush garden grove in ancient Nepal at spring morning, Lumbini: flowering sal trees, a pond, birds. Queen Maya (a gentle young Indian queen, dark hair in a loose braid with jasmine, soft rose and gold silk sari, gold bangles) steps down from a decorated palanquin, attendants in pale silks around her, smiling up at the blossoms. Warm gold light, deep blue shadows.
